dedupe_keys.name: eeweather weather preparation for energy models

description: EEweather is OpenDSM's Python package for matching locations to weather observations and typical-year data. It contains station selection, identifier translation, climate-zone assignments, data-quality warnings and source provenance. Inputs are coordinates or station identifiers, date ranges and variables; outputs are aligned UTC tables suitable for energy-efficiency calculations. Sources include NOAA GHCNh, NASA POWER, NLR TMY3 and California CZ2010 products, so geographic and temporal coverage varies by source. Package source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that CZ2010 data carry separate restrictions on international commercial use, and missing observations or distant stations can affect suitability. The package supports building-energy baselines and weather-dependent demand simulations. PyPSA (model-pypsa) provides related energy-system modelling. The README documents automatic station-registry updates and an option to disable them; no package or weather data was downloaded.
